request.text: My PC can drive 144 Hz over DisplayPort. What would I pay for a new 24-inch-class Full HD gaming monitor with DisplayPort and at least 144 Hz, delivered to Zahle?

message:
Best starting point: iSolved IT’s LG 24G411A-B at $114.00, VAT included. It is explicitly brand-new, 24-inch Full HD, with DisplayPort and 144Hz (OC). Delivery covers Lebanon, but the Zahle delivery fee is not published, so the delivered total remains unconfirmed.
• Electroslab: AOC 24G15N, $145.00; brand-new, 23.8-inch Full HD, 180Hz. Its website promotion gives free delivery on orders of $20 or more through Nov 30, making this $145.00 delivered during the promotion—but DisplayPort is not confirmed in the listing. The title and description also disagree on panel type.
• Karizma: MSI G244F E2, $150.00; 24-inch Full HD, 180Hz and DisplayPort confirmed. First-order shipping is advertised free; new condition and Zahle coverage are not explicitly confirmed.
All three show online availability. I’d choose the LG once its delivery charge is confirmed; use DisplayPort and enable the advertised 144Hz overclock mode.

product.description:
The Asus TUF Gaming VG249QM5A 24" 240Hz 0.3ms Monitor is a 24-inch gaming display from the Asus TUF Gaming line, with a 240Hz refresh rate and a 0.3ms response time.
It suits fast competitive games, where a high refresh rate and quick response help motion look smoother and clearer. It is a good fit for players who want a compact 24-inch screen for esports titles and a PC that can push high frame rates. Browse more gaming monitors to compare.
Highlights
24-inch screen size
240Hz refresh rate
0.3ms response time
Part of the Asus TUF Gaming series
Model VG249QM5A
Best for
Competitive and esports gaming at high frame rates
Fast shooters and racing games where motion clarity matters
Desks that need a compact 24-inch gaming display
Upgrading from a standard refresh rate monitor
Compatibility and related parts
To get the full benefit of 240Hz, your graphics card needs to deliver high frame rates in the games you play, and you should connect it with a port and cable on your GPU that support high refresh rates. Check the outputs on your graphics card against the monitor's inputs before you buy.
